channel.title: PMN+ Stories
channel.description: Pacific music, sport and culture from PMN+.

item.title: JuJu Smith-Schuster: Fire Within
item.description: JuJu Smith-Schuster on his clothing brand AFI, growing up Samoan in Long Beach, wearing the ‘ie faitaga on NFL game days, his Super Bowl run and advice for the next generation.

item.title: Siaosi: Blending Music & Business with Otai Beer Co.
item.description: Siaosi on founding Otai Beer Co., commissioning Tongan artist Luca Tu’avao Walton for the label, and the sound he found with Iznessbeats and Drumwise.

item.title: Nonosina Polynesia Takes the Jennifer Hudson Show Stage
item.description: Creative Director Tiana Liufau and co-creative Kayla Fa‘amaligi guided 48 dancers and 8 drummers through a Polynesian performance on The Jennifer Hudson Show, in Nonosina’s 60th anniversary year.

item.title: Ilaheva: The Duo Blending Worlds in Northern Sweden
item.description: Kasete Skeen and Melina Malke on building Ilaheva’s sound in northern Sweden, Skeen’s alpine skiing bid for Tonga at the 2026 Winter Olympics, and the EPs coming this year.

item.title: From the Islands to the Playoff Spotlight: Polynesian Excellence in the 2026 College Football Playoffs
item.description: Jordan Lockhart and the Pacific Islander players across the 2026 College Football Playoff field, plus the Miami–Indiana national championship matchup.

item.title: ARKATYPE Introduces a Purpose-Led Identity Mark for Jaron Keawe Sagapolutele
item.description: ARKATYPE powered by HEREAUX unveils an identity mark for Cal quarterback Jaron Keawe Sagapolutele — built from roots and sharpened for what’s next.

item.title: Jai Opetaia, The Cruiserweight King Unlocks a New Era With Zuffa Boxing
item.description: Jai Opetaia, 29–0 and the reigning IBF and Ring cruiserweight champion, signs with Zuffa Boxing — what it means for him, the division and the sport.

item.title: 2026: Your Year, Your Goals
item.description: Pick a word for 2026, break big goals into small steps, build habits that stick and find a mantra — plus seven quick tips for keeping your goals alive all year.

item.title: The January 2026 Playlist
item.description: The PMN+ January 2026 playlist: Damaiti Music, Sons of Zion, Samu ft. Baby Bash, The Yandall Sisters, OneFour, Tenelle, 62Music and more.

item.title: Adonia Faumuina
item.description: USC outside hitter Adonia Faumuina on her Samoan and Tongan roots, the back injury that tested her faith, and USC's first Pacific Islander Night for volleyball.

item.title: Lea Love: All Things New
item.description: Oceanside singer Lea Love on moving from R&B to island reggae, making “Together” with her husband Swells OC, and the new project she is readying for 2026.

item.title: Two Sons of the Pacific. One City. One Rivalry.
item.description: Jayden Maiava and Nico Iamaleava led USC and UCLA at the LA Memorial Coliseum — the first time two Samoan quarterbacks have run rival offenses in the Crosstown Showdown.

item.title: Pacific Pride: The 2025 Pacific Championships
item.description: Record crowds and 1.12 million viewers for the final made the 2025 Pacific Championships a watershed for Pacific rugby league — and set the stage for RLWC2026.

item.title: Coach Tavita Pritchard
item.description: Tavita Pritchard leaves the Washington Commanders to become Stanford's head football coach — returning to his alma mater as the program's first Samoan head coach.

item.title: Samuelu Elisaia's Journey with Faith and the FCA
item.description: Samuelu Elisaia on growing up a coach's kid, finding his own faith, leading the FCA at Utah, and building an FCA camp in the Pacific Islands.

item.title: RUNIT's USA West Coast Trials 2025
item.description: RUNIT took its collision sport to Las Vegas, Salt Lake City, Santa Monica, Irvine, Seattle and Austin — co-founder Noel Taua'a on heritage, unity and what comes next.

item.title: From Islands to Global Stages: Pasifika Excellence Shines at the TikTok Awards
item.description: Havea Matangi, Louis Davis and Lance Savali won three of the biggest honours at the 2025 TikTok Awards — a landmark night for Pasifika creators.

item.title: Trixx: The 20-Year-Old Artist From Tonga to Look Out For
item.description: Tongan artist Trixx on the Halataufa'ahau road behind his debut single, his brothers Malkeezy and Molotry, and making music that brings people together.

item.title: 5 Tips for Posting Your Content Without Worrying What Others Think
item.description: Five reminders for anyone sitting on content they have not posted — start before you feel ready, be authentic, stay consistent and track your own progress.

item.title: Holiday Word Search
item.description: PMN+'s holiday word search — seven festive words hidden in the grid, one for the aiga over the Christmas break.

item.title: PMN+ New Year Goals
item.description: Five goals for the year ahead from PMN+ — a concert, an NRL or NFL game, a trip home to the islands, a new cultural dish and sharing the magazine.

item.title: The December 2025 Playlist
item.description: PMN+'s December playlist — 10 Pacific tracks closing out Volume 2, from Tess So Original and K'Nova to Poetik, Sire and J Boog.

item.title: Aaradhna: The Soundtrack of Our Souls
item.description: Aaradhna on her first US shows in nearly a decade, her Samoan and Indian roots in Porirua, Sam Cooke, the Apollo Theatre and the home studio she calls her cave.

item.title: Beast Mode in Harmony: The Rise and Redemption of Johnny Suite
item.description: Hawai‘i artist Johnny Suite — Elijah Lagafuaina — on Kipapa Park, football at Mt. SAC, the studio call from Fiji, and the gratitude behind “Thank You.”

item.title: Fijiana: Reppin' Richmond, Rapping Her Truth, and Redefining Pasifika Pride
item.description: Indo-Fijian rapper Fijiana on “Welcome to the Bay,” Fiji Hindi bars over Bay Area drums, sensuality as resistance, and Indo-Fijians as Pacific Islanders.

item.title: Building Bridges Through Beats: Kiridox on Collaboration, Culture, and Coming Full Circle
item.description: Wellington artist Kiridox on his “PO’ SOME.” collaboration with Poetik, self-funding the video across Auckland and Wellington, and #TokoUso unity.

item.title: Josh Tatofi Lights Up Eden Park for Tonga at NZ Kiwis Clash
item.description: Josh Tatofi performed the Tongan national anthem and a post-match concert at Eden Park for Tonga v the New Zealand Kiwis, in front of more than 40,000 fans.

item.title: A New Year, a New Miss Samoa
item.description: Feagaimāli‘i Soti Mapu of Paradise Finance is Miss Samoa 2025–2026. Full results, runner-ups and the new queen's first words, plus a farewell to Litara Ieremia-Allan.

item.title: Kiwis Claim Victory Over Toa Samoa in Pacific Cup Final
item.description: The New Zealand Kiwis won the 2025 Pacific Cup, beating Toa Samoa 36-14 to close a Pacific Championships that united fans across the region.

item.title: Western Sydney Unites: Toa Samoa Fan Day Brings Thousands Together
item.description: Over 10,000 fans gathered at Eastern Creek for the Toa Samoa Fan Day before the Pacific Cup final, with Kennyon Brown and Bina Butta on what Western Sydney means.

item.title: Standing on the Shoulders of Those That Have Gone Before Us
item.description: The All Blacks beat Ireland 26-13 at Soldier Field. Ardie Savea, Wallace Sititi, Caleb Clarke and the Pacific talent behind the win, plus Savea on culture and faith.

item.title: The November 2025 Playlist
item.description: PMN+'s November playlist — 10 Pacific tracks blending throwbacks and new discoveries, from The 046 and Aaradhna to Fiji, Ardijah and Common Kings.

item.title: The Journey of Kennyon Brown
item.description: Samoan artist Kennyon Brown on family, DJ Noiz, island reggae and Project Love — the discipline and culture behind his rise across the Pacific.

item.title: Aloha on Screen: Brandon Finn on Chief of War
item.description: Hawaiian actor Brandon Finn on playing Prince Kupule in Jason Momoa's Chief of War, the show's use of ʻōlelo Hawai‘i, and hopes for a second season.

item.title: Carlos Ulberg Stuns Dominick Reyes With First-Round KO in UFC Main Event
item.description: Carlos Ulberg knocked out Dominick Reyes in round one of his first UFC main event in Perth, extending his streak to nine and eyeing a title shot.

item.title: Fiji Claims Sixth Pacific Nations Cup Title with Thrilling Win Over Japan
item.description: Fiji defeated Japan 33-27 to win the 2025 Pacific Nations Cup — a second straight and sixth overall title, in the first PNC final played in the United States.

item.title: Maile Soul: Lifting Pasifika Voices Through Music
item.description: Maile Soul on her gospel and R&B roots, reggae, and lifting the next generation of Pasifika artists — from Holo Holo Sacramento to Homecoming in Fiji.

item.title: Tongan Jams: K'Nova's First Tongan Track
item.description: K'Nova drops “Tongan Jams,” his first Tongan-language track, featuring Baby Joe — a nostalgic, mixtape-era single lighting up Pasifika TikTok.

item.title: Tuli Tuipulotu Breaks Out in Chargers' Narrow Loss to Giants
item.description: Chargers linebacker Tuli Tuipulotu recorded 10 tackles and 4 sacks against the Giants — a breakout game for the young Tongan pass rusher.

item.title: The October Soundtrack
item.description: PMN+'s October playlist — 10 handpicked Pacific tracks for every moment of your month, from Common Kings to Fiji, Josh Tatofi and Aaradhna.

item.title: This or That: October Edition
item.description: PMN+'s Halloween-season “this or that” — a fun would-you-rather across spooky vibes, fall favorites, food and pop culture for the whole aiga.

item.title: Inside the Noiz
item.description: DJ Noiz on cassette-tape mashups, building FutureNow Music as a family, touring the USA with Kennyon Brown, and giving back to the next generation.

item.title: TaioJr to Headline His First Hometown Show
item.description: TaioJr headlines House of Blues San Diego on September 6 with the city's first majority-Polynesian Hip-Hop lineup — a cultural milestone for his city and his people.

item.title: Baby Joe: Carrying Tongan Language Through Music
item.description: Tongan artist Baby Joe on weaving the Tongan language into every verse, what Tongan Language Week means to him, and keeping culture alive for the next generation.

item.title: Punialava'a: A Legendary Samoan Sound, A Multigenerational Legacy
item.description: Nanai, Puni and Melody on carrying Punialava'a forward from their father Lale Peteru, and on music as a vessel for Samoan language, culture and identity.

item.title: Romeo Toailoa Sabbath: The Voice Behind “Baby Fo‘i Mai”
item.description: Romeo Toailoa Sabbath on turning “Baby Come Back” into the Samoan hit “Baby Fo‘i Mai,” recording on his phone, and changing minds about Samoan covers.

item.title: Airplane Mode by Rappa Nui
item.description: Big Island artist Rappa Nui on “Airplane Mode” with Randin Napeahi, where his name came from, and being part of the growing wave of Pacific Island music.

item.title: Florinalaula'au “Nalu” Liufau: A Legacy Inked in Culture, Forged in Rugby
item.description: At 18, Florinalaula'au “Nalu” Liufau earned a Team USA rugby sevens contract — carrying the Liufau family legacy and a malu inked by her father, Si'i Liufau.

item.title: Faith, Family & Forks Up: The Polynesian Power of Jacob Kongaika
item.description: Arizona State defensive tackle Jacob Kongaika on Tongan roots, faith, NIL, retiring his dad early, and the Mater Dei choir nickname that still follows him.

item.title: The September 2025 Playlist
item.description: PMN+'s September playlist — 10 Pacific tracks blending throwbacks, trending hits and fresh discoveries, from L.A.B. and House of Shem to DJ Noiz and Aaradhna.
